svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 60 mm lengths of 50 x 40 x 3 mm channel; square and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deburr the ends, and break the sharp edges of the flange ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web (the 50 mm face that goes on the sign): two 6.5 mm holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm each side of centre, half way along (30 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges: one band slot in each, 3 mm wide and 14 mm long along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the channel, centred half way along and 8.5 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange end. Chain drill 3 mm and file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the web sits flat on the back of the sign face on two M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button-head bolts from the front, nyloc nuts inside the channel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two flange ends bear on the pole; the band runs in through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one slot, across in front of the pole, out of the other slot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and round the back of the pole. Poles 60 to 90 mm seat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both slots line up; the bolts clear the band.
